CSS rule '.news-ticker-track:hover { animation-play-state: paused; }' confirmed present in the compiled stylesheets. (5) REGRESSION: heal-art (admin-flagship-heal-art), heal-thumbnails (admin-flagship-heal-thumbnails), per-row Sparkles gen-art (admin-flagship-big-1062-uae-gen-art) all still render and are wired correctly. POST /api/admin/channels/thumbnails/heal-all still returns {ok, missing:int, started}. Ticker still renders + hides when empty (unchanged early-return null at NewsRadio.jsx:24).
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py:1819 auto-heal cron uses asyncio.sleep(86400) between runs — if the process is restarted (deploy, supervisor reload), the 15-min grace re-applies and the daily clock effectively resets. In practice this is fine (worst case: art heals ~15min after each boot instead of once/24h), but if boot storms happen (rolling restart during a deploy), you'll pay N Gemini/OpenAI calls in a short window. Consider persisting last-run-at in Mongo and skipping if <24h since last successful run.

backend/server.py:1826 cron logs only when fq or th.healed is nonzero. Ops has no positive heartbeat that the cron IS running (silent success looks identical to silent failure). Consider a debug-level 'no-op' log or a health probe (e.g. GET /api/admin/art-autoheal/last-run) so the fleet-health page can surface last-run-at.

frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminFlagshipStations.jsx:989 ArtGalleryModal.abs(u) treats 'http'-prefixed as external, else prefixes REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. If a legacy history entry stores a protocol-relative URL ('//cdn.example.com/x.webp'), it'll be mis-prefixed. Not observed in-fleet today (all history is /api/static/...) but worth a startsWith('//') guard.

frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminFlagshipStations.jsx:1029 restore button uses key={h.url + i}. If the same url appears twice due to a race (dedup logic archives on write, but two rapid restores could produce h.url === current) the key collision is masked by +i. Fine, but the underlying dedup lives in _archive_current_art (routes/imported_station_artwork.py:141) — a single choke point that's correct today.

frontend/src/NewsRadio.jsx:44 ticker duplicates the entries array for the seamless loop, so onClick fires with e.i for both copies — indices are correct. Test IDs however are non-unique ([data-testid=news-radio-ticker-item-2] appears twice). Playwright .first works today but a future test that counts distinct headlines will need to dedupe manually. Cosmetic — no user impact.
